# Project Reference Documents

Place NHS 365 project-specific reference documents here. ArcKit commands scan this
directory automatically when generating artifacts.

## Supported File Types
- PDF (.pdf), Word (.docx), Markdown (.md)
- Images (.png, .jpg) — diagrams and screenshots
- CSV (.csv) — data exports
- Subtitles/transcripts (.srt, .vtt) — meetings and recorded walkthroughs
- SQL (.sql) — database schemas

## Note
The NHS 365 source book is held at organisation scope in
`projects/000-global/external/` because it informs artifacts across all projects.

## See Also
- `projects/000-global/external/` — organisation-wide reference documents
- `projects/000-global/policies/` — governance policies
